title: Mistpine Stump
summary: Rare stump. Place anywhere: regrows a Mistpine Log every 1 min. Chop it for the log, a little Foraging XP and a good chance of a Splinter. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.

lines.x: Place anywhere: regrows a Mistpine Log every 1 min. Chop it for the log, a little Foraging XP and a good chance of a Splinter. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.
